answer: Let stake-weighted BFT replicas enforce deterministic thresholds n=3f+1 and quorum q=2f+1, so any two quorums intersect in at least f+1 validators; a trellis of verifiable delay proofs binds each signal to a unique slot, and under bound f malicious quorum intersection is mathematically impossible because honest stake exceeds one third. Slashing staked collateral for double signing imposes penalty s, giving expected attack utility B-(2f+1)s<0 when B<(2f+1)s, so honest SMR is a robust Nash equilibrium on tundra partitions.
